about: The four ending routes of the chapter The Ticket, written by hand from the Story Endings flowchart. A step with "ref" is a TarkovTracker step: it shares its marks and wiki link. A step with "if" applies only in that case and does not count. A "note" row has no buttons.

steps.text: Retrieve the armored case from the crashed plane on Woods
Decision: keep the case or hand it over to Prapor. The choice changes some steps of the Survivor and Fallen routes.
Keep the case for yourself
Hand over the case to Prapor
Find compromising material on Prapor on Lighthouse
steps.if: You handed the case to Prapor

steps.text: Gain access to Lightkeeper (the To the Light task line)
steps.if: You handed the case to Prapor

steps.text: Talk to Lightkeeper and pay him 3 TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials
steps.if: You handed the case to Prapor

steps.text: Launch a yellow signal flare in front of ULTRA's main entrance on Interchange
steps.if: You handed the case to Prapor

steps.text: Eliminate 15 targets in one raid on Interchange without dying
steps.if: You handed the case to Prapor

steps.text: Collect the case from Lightkeeper (it goes into the special slot)
steps.if: You handed the case to Prapor

steps.text: Find the experimental signal jammer in The Lab
Use the signal jammer to open the case
Decision: work with Mr. Kerman (Savior, Debtor and Fallen) or not (Survivor).
Accept Mr. Kerman's offer
Find the master keycard and the RFID device in The Lab
You have the keycard but not the device: talk to Mechanic
Pay Mechanic 40 Physical Bitcoins
Take Mechanic's keys to Elektronik's apartment and get the RFID device
Activate the RFID card from the armored case
Swipe the keycard at the intercom at the port entrance on Shoreline
Decision: help Mr. Kerman find evidence against TerraGroup (Savior), give him some and stop (Debtor), or refuse (Fallen).

survivor.title: Survivor: do not work with Mr. Kerman

steps.text: Swipe the keycard at the intercom at the port entrance on Shoreline
The keycard does not work: ask Prapor for help
Pay Prapor 300 million roubles
steps.if: You handed the case to Prapor

steps.text: Pay Prapor 500 million roubles
Find 4 TerraGroup report folders in The Lab
Give Prapor the flash drive with the data
steps.achievement: I am Speed (within 72 hours of game time)

steps.text: Hand over the Kappa secure container
steps.if: You gave the flash drive after more than 72 hours

steps.text: Eliminate 50 targets on Streets of Tarkov
Eliminate 4 PMCs in one raid and survive
Get Prapor's note for the soldiers at the Terminal
If the escape attempt fails, buy a new note from Prapor for 5 million roubles (2 per reset).

savior.title: Savior: help Mr. Kerman find evidence

steps.text: Listen to every audio tape and read every note that you find in all chapters: they are evidence.
Agree to find dirt on TerraGroup for Mr. Kerman
Hand over 8 major pieces of evidence to Mr. Kerman
Hand over all 32 minor pieces of evidence to Mr. Kerman
Upgrade the Intelligence Center to level 3
Mr. Kerman's trusted contact (Fence) gets in touch
Reach 4.0 reputation with Fence
Eliminate 5 PMCs in one raid on Shoreline and on Interchange without killing Scavs
Use the co-op extract with a Scav on Woods and on Reserve
Reach 0.4 reputation with the BTR Driver (complete The Price of Independence)
If you fail the BTR Driver reputation because you sided with Skier, Mr. Kerman stops helping you, and you must follow the Survivor route from "ask Prapor for help".
Build the Solar Power zone in the Hideout
Craft the keycard (the final craft)
If the escape attempt fails, craft the keycard again. Each craft needs a new blank RFID card.

debtor.title: Debtor: give Mr. Kerman some evidence, then stop

steps.text: Upgrade the Intelligence Center to level 3
Hand over 2 major pieces of evidence to Mr. Kerman, then stop working with him
Gain access to Lightkeeper (Network Provider part 1 is available)
Talk to Lightkeeper
Find the topographic reconnaissance: 5 in total, 1 on each of 5 maps
Bring a special flash drive with the material to Lightkeeper
Eliminate 30 PMCs on Woods
Hand over 100 PMC dogtags
Find a Cultist amulet in each marked room
Put all the amulets in the stash on Lightkeeper's island on Lighthouse
Get the keycard for the Terminal from Lightkeeper
If the escape attempt fails, barter a new keycard from Lightkeeper for 1 TerraGroup "Blue Folders" material.

fallen.title: Fallen: refuse to help Mr. Kerman

steps.text: Refuse to help Mr. Kerman find evidence
Talk to Prapor
Hand over 40 repair kits (100% durability, not found in raid)
Hand over a Kappa, Theta or Epsilon secure container
Hand over 50 military components such as Virtex and COFDM (not found in raid)
Get the "case with dangerous cargo" and hand it over to Prapor
Hand over 1 million dollars to Prapor
Get the USB stick with Prapor's hash code
Build the Solar Power zone in the Hideout
Craft the keycard (the final craft)
If the escape attempt fails, craft the keycard again. Each craft needs a new blank RFID card.

escapeText: Go to Shoreline between 21:00 and 06:00, talk to the intercom at the tower, swipe your keycard, go to the Terminal with no weapon in your hands, and start the escape attempt
